title: Rosetta credentials helper stdin EPIPE containment

installed_red.authority: T00 installed Rosetta receipt supplied to T20
installed_red.post_dialog_observation: After dismissal, the application continued, completed the Profile update and automatically restarted.
installed_red.separation: The EPIPE is an independent credentials helper startup defect. It does not change or reopen T09 updater/relaunch ownership.

source_root_cause.before: Every invocation spawned stdin as a pipe, installed no child.stdin error listener, and immediately called child.stdin.end(input).
source_root_cause.failure: When a translated helper exited before buffered stdin completed, Node emitted EPIPE on child.stdin without a listener, escaping the runner Promise as an uncaught exception.
source_root_cause.shared_boundary_repair: Empty input now uses ignored stdin. Non-empty input alone uses a pipe whose one-shot error listener enters the existing settled fail path before end(input).

nonempty_input: macOS expect helper receives base64 credential bytes plus a newline for Keychain writes
Windows DPAPI protect and unprotect receive JSON on stdin
Windows DPAPI probe receives non-secret JSON on stdin
caller_audit.secret_semantics: Credential bytes remain stdin-only and are not written to plaintext files, arguments, evidence, logs or manifests.

red.method: Node 24 direct source import with transform-types and a local .js-to-.ts resolver; one deterministic helper closes fd 0 while a 1 MiB input is buffered.
red.result: FAIL_EXPECTED: Unhandled 'error' event; Error: write EPIPE; code EPIPE; Node.js v24.19.0

verification.name: focused credentials runner regression

verification.result: PASS: deterministic EPIPE before and during input, empty-input ignore, non-empty input/output, nonzero exit, spawn error and stdout boundary
